about:
Atlantic Cable operates from Exeter, New Hampshire, as a wholesale supplier of cables and connectivity accessories. The company serves the wholesale market with a broad product line and custom assembly capabilities.

The company stocks thousands of items across hundreds of product lines, including Ethernet patch cables, fiber, HDMI, USB, coaxial, and power cords. In addition to off-the-shelf inventory, Atlantic Cable custom-builds cables and accessories in-house to meet specific customer requirements. Orders placed before 4:30 PM EST ship the same day, and there is no minimum order quantity.

Atlantic Cable sells primarily to wholesale buyers, including distributors, resellers, and installers in the telecommunications, data networking, and audio-visual sectors. Its product range covers connectivity needs for commercial and residential installations.

The company emphasizes its technically trained customer service team, direct manufacturer purchasing to keep pricing competitive, and the ability to produce custom cable assemblies quickly. These factors, combined with same-day shipping and no minimum orders, form the core of its value proposition.
